about: A memory note written by hand (2026-09-27, the chat-fixes lane): a plain `.md` file with no front matter under a folder whose namespace is known is that namespace's note, keyed by its file name and marked `owner`; a file under a caller folder that names no caller (namespace empty) stays nobody's, and an empty file is not a note. `text` is the file's bytes, `namespace` and `key` what the folder and file name say, `entry` what both stores read (null: not an entry). Front matter still wins. Python: tests/agents/skills/test_chat_fixes_hand_written_note.py (parse_entry_file); TypeScript: tests/unit/skills/memory/chat-fixes-hand-written-note.test.ts (parseEntryFile).

cases.text:

9 to 5, Monday to Friday.
